notes:
Quick CRM notes:
- Customer: multilingual enterprise search for legal documents (contracts, filings, counsel notes).
- Scale ask: index ~200M documents (~400M text chunks). We expect heavy tail languages (pl, nl, pt-br, ar, ja) plus en/fr/de.
- Architecture preference: hybrid retrieval (sparse + dense) + cross-encoder reranker for top-10. They want per-language reranker fine-tuning and separate recall targets.
- Quoted pain: "we get good English recall but non-English drops 15-20% in top-5; needs consistent quality across locales."
- Security: EU data residency mandatory for EU corp data; will require dedicated VPC or on-prem nodes for sensitive corpora. DPA + ISO docs requested.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for dedicated nodes if cost/QPS predictable; wants cost modeling at 100 qps baseline and 500 qps peak.
- SE notes: evaluate quantized embedding model vs float for memory; consider language-specific index sharding and per-lang recall tuning.
- Decision cadence: procurement committee meeting mid-May; procurement + legal sign-off after perf report.
- Staging: PoC environment (hosted sandbox) -> dedicated trial -> legal negotiation -> procurement.
- Quote references: Drive deck + RL ticket with embedding pipeline spec.
use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG for legal workflows: fast cross-lingual retrieval + high-precision reranking. Primary flows: contract search, multi-language discovery, jurist Q&A. Priorities: per-language recall parity, predictable cost at scale, audit logging.
technical_requirements: Indexing: ~200M documents; ingest pipeline must handle PDFs + OCR transcriptions. Embeddings: multilingual model or per-language models; prefer models with quantization support. Reranking: cross-encoder for final ranking; training/fine-tune allowed. Infrastructure: dedicated GPU pool or VPC deployment for sensitive subsets; per-request language detection and route to appropriate index shard. Must provide token-level cost breakdown and latency traces.
per_language_targets: Targets: EN/FR/DE top-5 recall >= 92%, Precision@5 >= 85%. PL/NL/PT/JA/AR target top-5 recall >= 80% (improve to 85% after tuning). Response P95 latency target <= 250ms for hosted, <=150ms on dedicated. P99 tail < 500ms. Cost target: < $0.02/query at 100 qps baseline (including reranker amortized).
indexing_estimate: ~200,000,000 documents / ~400,000,000 chunks after chunking (avg chunk size 512 tokens). Estimated vector store size (float16): ~1.6TB; with PQ/quantization targeted to 350-500GB.
perf_targets: Latency: 95th <=250ms hosted, 95th <=150ms dedicated. Throughput: baseline 100 qps sustained; burst to 500 qps for 1-2 minutes. Availability: 99.9% SLA desired. Cost visibility and per-route cost breakdown required.
cost_constraints: Primary buyer: platform engineering. Tight budgeting for cloud egress and GPU hours. Wants clear cost model for: embedding compute (ingest), storage (vectors), and reranker GPU time. Must compare dedicated vs hosted with example runs (100 qps, 24/7).
